title: Primal-Dual Halpern-PAGE Algorithm for Constrained Stochastic Weakly Convex Optimization
summary: We tackle the challenging problem of stochastic weakly convex optimization subject to mixed (equality and inequality) expected-value constraints. While optimal $\mathcal{O}(ε^{-3})$ sample complexity algorithms exist for unconstrained weakly convex problems, dealing with complex functional constraints typically requires cumbersome multi-loop penalty or augmented Lagrangian methods, which suffer from high inner-loop complexity and sensitive parameter tuning.
